## Type of change

- [ ] New skill (`feat(skill): ...`)
- [ ] Bug fix in an existing skill (`fix(skill-name): ...`)
- [ ] Docs update (`docs: ...`)
- [ ] Infra / CI (`chore: ...`)
- [ ] Release prep (`chore(release): ...`)

## Skill anatomy checklist (for skill PRs)

- [ ] YAML frontmatter includes `name`, `description` starting with "Use this skill to ...", `license`, `metadata.author`, `metadata.version`, `metadata.target_media3_version`, `metadata.last_reviewed`, `keywords`
- [ ] Prerequisites section with hard **MUST** / **MUST NOT** gates
- [ ] Step 1: plan
- [ ] Numbered steps with RIGHT / WRONG code pairs for every non-trivial pattern
- [ ] Common pitfalls grounded in production bugs
- [ ] Body between 10k and 20k characters (CI enforces 20k hard ceiling)
- [ ] All code blocks tagged with a language
- [ ] No em dashes, no contractions
- [ ] No `@ExperimentalApi` class in any RIGHT example
- [ ] `metadata.last_reviewed` set to today
